path.title: Frontend Development
path.description: Master modern frontend development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React. Build responsive, interactive web applications from scratch.

nodes.title: Internet Basics
nodes.description: Understanding how the internet works, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, DNS, and web browsers.
nodes.topic_keywords: internet, http, https, dns, browser, web

nodes.title: HTML Fundamentals
nodes.description: Learn semantic HTML5, document structure, forms, and accessibility basics.

nodes.title: CSS Basics
nodes.description: Master CSS selectors, box model, typography, colors, and basic layouts.

nodes.title: CSS Layouts
nodes.description: Deep dive into Flexbox, Grid, positioning, and responsive design principles.

nodes.title: JavaScript Basics
nodes.description: Learn JavaScript fundamentals: variables, types, functions, and control flow.

nodes.title: DOM Manipulation
nodes.description: Interact with web pages using the Document Object Model and event handling.

nodes.title: Async JavaScript
nodes.description: Master promises, async/await, fetch API, and handling asynchronous operations.
nodes.topic_keywords: async, promises, fetch, api, await, callbacks

nodes.title: ES6+ Features
nodes.description: Modern JavaScript: arrow functions, destructuring, modules, spread operator, and more.

nodes.title: Git & GitHub
nodes.description: Version control with Git: commits, branches, merges, and collaboration on GitHub.

nodes.title: Package Managers
nodes.description: npm, yarn, and pnpm: managing dependencies and scripts in JavaScript projects.

nodes.title: Build Tools
nodes.description: Webpack, Vite, and Parcel: bundling, transpiling, and optimizing your code.
nodes.topic_keywords: webpack, vite, bundler, babel, transpile, build

nodes.title: React Basics
nodes.description: Introduction to React: components, JSX, props, and state management fundamentals.
nodes.topic_keywords: react, jsx, components, props, state, jsx

nodes.title: React Hooks
nodes.description: Master useState, useEffect, useContext, and custom hooks for stateful logic.

nodes.title: React Router
nodes.description: Client-side routing with React Router: navigation, params, and protected routes.

nodes.title: State Management
nodes.description: Redux, Zustand, and Context API: managing global state in React applications.

nodes.title: Styled Components
nodes.description: CSS-in-JS with Styled Components: component-based styling and theming.

nodes.title: Tailwind CSS
nodes.description: Utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development and responsive design.

nodes.title: TypeScript
nodes.description: Add type safety to JavaScript: interfaces, generics, and type inference.

nodes.title: Testing Basics
nodes.description: Unit and integration testing with Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress.

nodes.title: Next.js
nodes.description: Full-stack React framework: SSR, SSG, API routes, and file-based routing.

nodes.title: Performance
nodes.description: Web performance optimization: lazy loading, code splitting, and Core Web Vitals.

nodes.title: Authentication
nodes.description: Implement auth: JWT, OAuth, session management, and protected routes.

nodes.title: PWA
nodes.description: Progressive Web Apps: service workers, offline support, and app-like experiences.

nodes.title: Deployment
nodes.description: Deploy your apps: Vercel, Netlify, CI/CD pipelines, and production best practices.
